summary: Make maintenance release acceptance self-contained and Cloudflare-compatible.
details: Commits 7d7171924f5869b6012e362cf66e57d43d38dcd9 and d8df2aca053d7be3f4636e5f0129b471ae303f99 make the maintenance runner mint its 60-second read-only candidate probe token in memory, give authenticated acceptance POSTs the same declared release User-Agent as GET checks, reject incorrectly prefixed Python runtime digest evidence during preparation, and reuse the running candidate for the post-start authority digest instead of contending for its fixed proxy address.
operator_impact: Maintenance releases no longer require an operator-created acceptance-token file, Cloudflare receives the declared release User-Agent, and the post-start authority check completes without a one-off container network collision.
